title: Shades of New Orleans and Lizzie Miles
summary: She missed the TV program about Jelly; they recall Lizzie Miles, who knew and recorded with him.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: No, I was up in Missouri, taking care of my mother. Oh, yes. And she broke her hip during those two years. Uh-huh. So, I didn't—I never did even get to see that. I've heard it. Yeah. Because Dick Allen has a—
I wish you had— They have the tape. I wish you had come around when Lizzie was— You know this girl that sang Creole in the French Quarter? She just died just recently.
It's the colored woman that used to sing all these— Oh, Miles.
Yeah, Lizzie Miles. That's right. Well, she knew my brother well, too. Oh, yes.
She would have known him very well. She made records with him. Mm-hmm. She knew him very well. It's on the Victor Record, one of them, where she sang— Yes, I'm sure, yeah. Yes, I knew her quite well.
